title: Love Hina
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Keitaro Urashima has failed the Tokyo University entrance exam twice and is kicked out by his parents. His grandmother's Hinata inn turns out to be a girls' dormitory, and he becomes its manager among its female residents. He keeps studying for Todai, partly to keep a childhood promise to a girl he can't remember, while a chaotic romance builds among the residents (MU Love Polygon).
life_message: Perseverance through repeated failure and keeping faith with a promise can win a future and a love.

content.note: Running slapstick in which the girls punch, kick and send Keitaro flying, played as comedy (to verify); MU Hot-Blooded Female Lead.
Accidental groping, hot-spring and bath nudity in a 'five sexy ladies' harem comedy (Kodansha blurb via AniList; MU Ecchi, Hot Spring/s; AniList Nudity; MangaDex suggestive).
Insults like 'pervert' and mild profanity (to verify).
Exam failure and being cast out by parents (Kodansha blurb; MU Ronin Student).
Hitting a boy as a joke; peeping misunderstandings (to verify).
